decision: Accept the SOI endpoint slope correction; SOI remains opt-in.
scope: At step zero, update the slope only when a basic value leaves its feasible interval. A fixed variable contributes once at zero and twice at nonzero crossings. Ordinary repair policies and explanation construction are unchanged.
basis: King, Barrett and Dutertre, FMCAD 2013, Section V-A; King thesis Section 3.3.1; implementation checklist in docs/arithmetic.md#soi-endpoint-correction.

environment.execution: All solver tests, sanitizer runs, reference comparisons and fuzzing ran in SLURM compute allocations. Local work was lint, documentation and static analysis of four documentation examples.
environment.release: GNU C++ 11.4.1, Release, assertions enabled for unit tests, CaDiCaL 3.0.0-7b99c07; matching pre-provisioned header manifest
environment.asan: GCCcore 11.3.0, Debug, PRIMO_SANITIZERS=address, ASAN_OPTIONS=detect_leaks=1:strict_init_order=1; matching C system headers

resources.timing_scope: Concurrent correctness qualification, not an isolated performance measurement.

commands.checks: sbatch scripts/qualification/soi_endpoints/checks.sbatch; runs make -j4 check BUILD_DIR=build-slurm-rel, seed comparisons and the component reproduction
commands.local: make lint; clang-format --dry-run --Werror docs-next/examples/*.cpp; make docs-check-links

fuzz_environment.note: The two seed paths satisfy the existing wrapper preflight; no mutation task ran.

verification.seed_scope: 3 QF_LRA seeds, 2 QF_LIA smoke inputs and 12 QF_UFLRA seeds, each under SOI and sparse; 2 new SOI endpoint regressions with preprocessing off.
verification.component_comparison: Historical diagnostic 2026-09-28-soi-zero-breakpoint-debug needed two pivots for the same valid final assignment.
verification.lint: Complete local make lint passed, including Ruff and C++ formatting. Remote make check lacked rg and the configured Ruff environment, so its partial lint is not the formatting/Python lint evidence.
verification.static_review: Normal clang-tidy returned zero after all 126 source/test translation units; four documentation examples also passed locally. The 18 visible normal diagnostics are 16 deliberate invalid-enum test casts, one external CLI11 advisory, and the previously recorded tactic.cpp:69 shared_ptr control-block leak advisory. Reinspection confirms ownership through Goal::data_ -> Data::assertions, no cycle or manual release; leak-enabled ASan passes. No diagnostic in the changed arithmetic source or tests. Advisory scans cover all 130 files: 404 source/test and 7 example include advisories inspected, with no spurious include identified. No warning-free baseline claim.
verification.docs: make docs-check-links passed both strict books: 127 pages, 19323 local links, 558 unique Git links, zero failures. All anchors in 131 prior HTML files retained. 173 external URLs deferred to HTTP audit.
verification.static_job_completion: Job 153101 completed its normal clang-tidy stage with exit zero. Its redundant serial include-cleaner stage was intentionally cancelled after job 153110 had already completed that scan on all 126 files. static-stage-transition.txt records the stage boundary; include-cleaner.log could only be opened after the successful first command under set -e.
verification.code_review: No blocking issues found; soundness, one-sided slopes, exact arithmetic, rollback, ownership, explanations, include hygiene and hot-path costs reviewed.

fuzz_summary.failure_classification: All 42 retained non-pass inputs are timeouts; no stale bug corpus is used as evidence.

superseded_setup_attempts.cause: Archive mtimes made existing dependency stamps stale, so make tried blocked downloads. MAKEFLAGS did not suppress those targets. No solver results from these jobs are counted.
superseded_setup_attempts.resolution: After the helper validated existing dependency headers/libraries/versions, each installation stamp was set to its corresponding installer-script mtime; make -n contrib-required then reported nothing to do. Fresh jobs 153104/153105 passed.
superseded_setup_attempts.build_warnings: Compute-node/filesystem clock skew produced make timestamp warnings. Source/build trees were freshly configured; revision preflights and complete normal/ASan suites passed.

limitations: 42 timeout cases are not agreements or proofs of correctness.
This is an opt-in selection repair, not a full-corpus performance evaluation or default promotion.

No new independent printed-model validation or seed-mutation campaign was run. The merge gate uses generated QF_LRA inputs; existing tests and small QF_LIA/QF_UFLRA seed comparisons provide additional coverage.
External HTTP links were not re-audited; source and local HTML links were checked.
